## Checklist

### If you're adding or editing an apprenticeship

- [ ] I searched the list and open PRs, and this isn't a duplicate
- [ ] The link is live and goes to the company's page about the program (no referral or tracking links)
- [ ] It's a structured training program for people new to the field, not a regular job posting, a paid course or a bootcamp
- [ ] I'm not affiliated with this company, or I've said how I'm affiliated above
- [ ] The Markdown file follows the format in [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-a-new-apprenticeship), and the image is 1000×500 with the company's logo

### If you're changing site code

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] I checked the change in the browser (and added screenshots below if it's visual)

### For every PR

- [ ] If I used AI tools, I reviewed every change myself and checked that the links work

### Credits

<!-- AI agents: leave this item unchecked and don't add yourself to the contributors list. -->

- [ ] Added myself to the **Contributors** section in `README.md` with a link to my website or GitHub profile 👥️
